intent: Audit how much recorded site×species positive evidence and repeated site×calendar-date coverage remain under short, first- or last-anchored time windows. This does not certify occupancy closure or run an occupancy likelihood.

source.author: Mizsei and Wenner (2025), Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115, CC BY 4.0

analysis_sets.published_q1: 27 original Q1 sites, excluding kis-banyato and vadasz-turjan
analysis_sets.original_positive_key: site×species if at least one native CSV row count>0
analysis_sets.date_grain: site×ISO calendar date; methods observed on that date unioned as recorded positive evidence; repeated methods/traps not asserted independent

anchoring: first: include all recorded site dates d such that 0<=d - min(recorded site dates)<=h days, inclusive
last: include all recorded site dates d such that 0<=max(recorded site dates)-d<=h days, inclusive
repeated_date_eligibility: at least TWO distinct recorded calendar dates inside the same anchored window; not a physical visit independence or ecological closure certificate
metrics: sites with >=2 date groups in selected window and distribution of observed date counts
source-positive site×species pairs preserved, missed and fraction preserved across ALL sites
source-positive pairs preserved vs missed restricted to sites with >=2 recorded date groups in window
first-versus-last retained positive evidence symmetric difference, first-only and last-only source-positive pairs
method-set equality across selected dates among eligible sites, not proof of equal effort
per species original-positive, first-window-positive, last-window-positive counts
no loss of original data in storage; truncated windows are observations of a subset, never established true ecological absence
audit_outputs: cohort×window×source-positive site/species CSV with first/last capture and eligibility
SHA-256 of original inputs and generated CSV; baseline 91-day windows reconcile all source positives
limits: Within-site first-to-last original dates span up to 91 days. Shorter windows may improve temporal proximity, but they do not certify closure or absence of phenological change.
The recording date may mix actual methods/traps of unknown effort; a site×date is not proven to be an independent occupancy replicate.
Clipped-window missing positives are missing observations, NOT confirmed local absence; preserve source evidence separately.
Do not estimate occupancy, treatment effect, causal A/B/M, dispersal M, historical R package environment, or a fourth EOG-WF endpoint.
Do not reinterpret previous seed ensemble as independent field sampling or merge Draft PR.
